hooks.text: I didn't expect one conversation to change my perspective on building.
They told me first-year was too early to think about my personal brand. They were wrong.
I walked in with a laptop and left with a framework for life.
Most people spent their Sunday resting. I spent mine compounding.
I came with a laptop and an unreasonable amount of optimism.
I went looking for inspiration and found a few more tabs to open.
Another day of turning caffeine and curiosity into a career strategy.

learnings.text: every handshake is a warm lead
the real internship was the network we built along the way
impact starts with showing up and taking a photo

conclusions.text: Excited to keep building and learning.
Grateful for the journey, and humbled to be just getting started.
If you're hiring interns for summer 2027, my inbox is open.
Grateful for the conversations, the caffeine, and the chance to keep learning.
Taking the ideas with me and adding the rest to my very ambitious to-do list.
Proof that showing up is a pretty good first step, even without a five-year plan.
